method: AI-v1 monthly census -> weekly activation tranche (mechanical: max(10, 6% live), current stars desc)
note: Discovery-frontier denominator (un-backfillable). Candidates are systems CONSIDERED at scan time, not judgments; admission happens via a paired seeds.json change (CI enforces the pairing). Positive-only: no per-system negatives are recorded.
retro_note: Extended the same day: the first tranche of 20 was followed by the remainder of the pending queue in one act after the 2026-09-20 growth-policy amendment. Candidates are appended, never removed; the day's denominator therefore grows, which is what happened.
